title: the corner column is 300 wide at 1080p, and world names stay out from under the HUD plates
why: The follow-up on his one column order (2026-10-18), settled by the coordinator. (1) Width: the column was the run info panel width, 321 px at 1080p; the picture he chose in the menu survey (q16 A and q20 A) is 300, so the column is 300 px at 1080p (600 at 4k, the same share of the screen at other sizes), every row, the minimap square and the run info panel together. (2) The world name labels (the purple cache names, the nameplates, the party names, the strongbox and the forge names) are drawn under the HUD plates, so they showed in the 8 px gaps between the rows and round the edges of the score and clock plate. A label is no longer drawn while its rectangle overlaps the corner column or the score and clock plate, in career, in the demo and in the two player demo.
now: The corner column is 300 wide, and the names of caches and people no longer show through the gaps in the HUD.
